product_metadata.title: Chardin home Cordural Stripes Bath Mat, Set of 2 Bath Rugs (17 Inches x24 Inches & 21 Inches x34 Inches) | Non Slip Bathroom Rug, Machine Washable, Plush, Highly Absorbent | Ombre Dark Grey & White
features: 100% Cotton – Superior high-quality yarns. Imported – Styled in USA. Our exclusively designed bath rug has cut pile on the surface with spray latex applied on the back to improve skid resistance. These fashion colors create a perfect harmony that will match most towels and bath accessories available in the market. The soft, highly absorbent cotton will feel fluffy and absorbent on your feet!

EXTRA SOFT BATH RUG: Luxurious & super soft premium quality 100% Cotton Bath Rug. Give a luxurious spa like feeling & look to your bathroom. Making it Perfect for the master bathroom, Children bathroom, vanity, guest suite. Great gift idea for all occasions, housewarming, Christmas, Wedding, Father’s Day, Mother’s Day, Valentines, Birthdays, & more.

HIGHLY ABSORBENT - These bath rugs are noticeably more absorbent and deliver maximum comfort with each use. Cotton being a natural fiber will lint in first couple of washes; however, with each wash the yarns become stronger & super absorbent.

WASH CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Machine washable separately in cold water. Use a mild soap. Do not bleach. Tumble dry low. Remove rug from dryer and shake well when almost dry, this will prolong life of the rug.

QUALITY ASSURANCE: Chardin Home uses the best 100% cotton superior yarns. Be aware of the fake or copies of our design. We offer various colors and size options in this beautiful & exclusive design. Soft to the touch, SPA-like quality, and comfort that is durable to hold up for a long time.
